CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 04 / 12

Economic thinking and models

Circular flow經濟循環

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Read the circular-flow diagram: households own and sell factors of production and buy goods; firms buy factors and sell goods. Trace the corresponding flows of goods, inputs and money.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

家庭提供勞工、土地及資本，並購買商品；企業購買要素並出售商品。實物流向與相應付款方向相反。

Households supply factors to firms and buy goods from firms. Firms pay factor incomes and receive sales revenue. Real goods and inputs flow in the opposite direction to the associated money payments.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：You work in a bakery and receive wages through the factor market; buying bread uses the goods market. 你在餅店工作和買麵包屬不同市場。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

In the factor market, households are usually what? 家庭在生產要素市場扮演什麼角色？
